globalRequirements: icon-only controls provide aria-label or equivalent accessible name
color is not the only status indicator
selected, active, current, checked, pressed, expanded are not interchangeable

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: button
componentBaselines.notes: Button.md owns exact visual state recipe.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: button
componentBaselines.notes: Icon-only usage requires accessible name.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: textbox
componentBaselines.notes: Label/helper/error relation must remain explicit.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: checkbox
componentBaselines.notes: Checked is not selected or active.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: radio
componentBaselines.notes: Radio Group owns repeated option relation.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: switch
componentBaselines.notes: On/off is not selected/current.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: trigger plus listbox/menu depending on usage
componentBaselines.notes: Selection dropdown and command menu semantics must not be mixed.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: menu or action list depending on implementation
componentBaselines.notes: Menu is command/action surface, not selection dropdown.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: dialog
componentBaselines.notes: Background focus must be blocked and focus must return to trigger.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: non-blocking floating panel
componentBaselines.notes: Popover may include focusable content; Tooltip must not.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: tooltip
componentBaselines.notes: Tooltip cannot contain focusable content.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: table/grid depending on interaction
keyboard: row/cell navigation only if interactive grid
componentBaselines.notes: Table owns column/row structure; Table Cell owns cell shell.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: status or alert depending on severity
componentBaselines.notes: Toast is summary feedback; complex recovery belongs inline or modal.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: region or section depending on screen placement
componentBaselines.notes: Content foundation owns wording hierarchy.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: navigation with breadcrumb accessible name
componentBaselines.notes: Current location uses aria-current when rendered as a link or current item.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: tab inside tablist
keyboard: Enter or Space when manual activation
componentBaselines.notes: Selected tab and current navigation state must not be mixed.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: tablist or navigation depending on destination model
componentBaselines.notes: Use tab semantics only when panels are switched in place.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: tablist or segmented navigation depending on usage
componentBaselines.notes: Direction variant does not change selected/current semantic distinction.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: date textbox or combobox with calendar dialog trigger
keyboard: Enter or Space to open calendar when trigger is focused
componentBaselines.notes: CalendarSurface owns overlay composition; DateInput owns single-date field semantics.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: group containing start and end date fields
keyboard: Enter or Space to open calendar when trigger is focused
componentBaselines.notes: Start and end labels must remain distinguishable to assistive technology.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: searchbox or textbox inside search landmark/region depending on placement
componentBaselines.notes: Search query behavior is product-specific; accessible label must not be only placeholder text.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: combobox with listbox options or native select depending on implementation
componentBaselines.notes: Selection state must be exposed as option selection, not active/current.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: multiline textbox
keyboard: Tab navigation according to product editing policy
componentBaselines.notes: Helper/error relation follows Form Layout and content foundation.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: label or accessible name provider
componentBaselines.notes: fieldLabel is not a standalone control; it names another form control.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: group or removable field value row depending on parent context
keyboard: Tab to checkbox/remove action when interactive
Enter or Space for remove button
componentBaselines.notes: Field Item exposes child Checkbox and remove button semantics; parent owns field value meaning and data behavior.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: multi-select listbox or menu with checkbox items depending on trigger contract
componentBaselines.notes: Checked is not selected/current; visible check state must have semantic equivalent.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: single-select listbox or radiogroup depending on trigger contract
componentBaselines.notes: Exactly one selected option is expected unless the component document states empty selection is allowed.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: separator when semantic, presentation when purely decorative
componentBaselines.notes: Decorative dividers should not add noise to the accessibility tree.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: presentation placeholder with loading status handled by parent region
requiredStates: hidden from assistive tech when redundant
componentBaselines.notes: Skeleton preserves layout rhythm; parent region announces loading when needed.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: text/status indicator depending on surrounding context
keyboard: not interactive unless wrapped by a control
componentBaselines.notes: Color cannot be the only status signal; label text carries the meaning.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: text token, option, or removable button depending on variant
keyboard: Tab to remove action when removable
componentBaselines.notes: Trailing remove affordance requires its own accessible name.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: cell, columnheader, rowheader, or gridcell depending on table model
keyboard: grid navigation only when parent Table is interactive grid
componentBaselines.notes: Table Cell owns cell shell, while Table owns row/column interaction model.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: cell, columnheader, rowheader, or gridcell depending on data table model
keyboard: grid navigation only when parent Data Table is interactive grid
componentBaselines.notes: Data Table Cell owns compact dataGrid cell shell; parent Data Table owns row/column interaction and editing transaction.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: gridcell or columnheader depending on sheet table model
keyboard: spreadsheet navigation only when parent Sheet Table defines it
componentBaselines.notes: Sheet Table Cell owns sheetsGrid visual cell states; parent Sheet Table owns range selection, drag behavior, and editing commit.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: status or alert depending on severity and urgency
componentBaselines.notes: InlineAlert is placed near the affected content and should not duplicate Toast as the only error channel.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: visual status marker with adjacent text or accessible label
componentBaselines.notes: Dot color alone is insufficient; text or accessible status meaning must be present.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: visual priority marker with adjacent text or accessible label
componentBaselines.notes: Dot count/color must not be the only priority signal.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: progressbar
keyboard: not interactive unless combined with a control
componentBaselines.notes: Expose value now/min/max for determinate progress when implementation supports it.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: slider
componentBaselines.notes: Accessible name, value text, min, max, and step must be available.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: banner with primary navigation and utility controls
keyboard: Escape to close opened utility overlays
componentBaselines.notes: GNB owns top shell order and focus path; child controls own exact button/menu semantics.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: navigation region with expandable item groups
keyboard: Arrow keys only when implemented as tree
componentBaselines.notes: Current navigation, expanded disclosure, and selected data state must remain separate.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: page landmarks containing banner, navigation, main, and complementary regions
componentBaselines.notes: Page Layout owns landmark order and region relation, not child component roles.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: toolbar or action region depending on screen context
componentBaselines.notes: Action Bar groups screen actions; individual Search, Button, Filter, and menu controls keep their own semantics.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: button controlling side navigation collapsed/expanded state
componentBaselines.notes: Expose controlled navigation state with expanded/collapsed semantics when implemented.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: button or menu trigger for user/tenant utility actions
keyboard: Arrow keys inside menu when menu opens
componentBaselines.notes: Do not expose icon glyph text as the accessible name.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: tablist accessory or toolbar control for adding/overflowing tabs
keyboard: Arrow keys stay owned by tablist
componentBaselines.notes: tabAdd does not own individual tab semantics.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: ordered list or navigation for process steps
keyboard: Enter or Space when steps are clickable
componentBaselines.notes: Current step should be communicated with text/state, not progress color alone.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: group or toolbar containing related buttons
keyboard: Tab through buttons or roving focus when implemented as toolbar
componentBaselines.notes: Child Button owns individual button state and accessible name.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: toolbar or group containing icon buttons
keyboard: Tab or roving focus through icon buttons
componentBaselines.notes: Every icon-only child must have an accessible name.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: form, fieldset, or grouped field layout depending on scope
keyboard: logical Tab order through labels, controls, messages, actions
componentBaselines.notes: Form Layout owns label/control/message relation and action placement.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: group containing multiple checkboxes
componentBaselines.notes: Group label must describe the set; child Checkbox owns checked state.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: radiogroup
componentBaselines.notes: Only one radio option is selected within a group unless the component document states otherwise.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: group containing independent switches
componentBaselines.notes: Each switch remains an independent on/off control.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: list/listitem or feed depending on content and interaction
keyboard: Arrow navigation only when implemented as composite widget
componentBaselines.notes: List is content structure; menu/dropdown/table semantics must not be substituted.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: button controlling collapsible region
componentBaselines.notes: Expanded state must be exposed on the trigger and associated with the controlled region.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: navigation region for paged content
componentBaselines.notes: Current page must be programmatically distinguishable.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: dialog or popover containing calendar grid
componentBaselines.notes: DateInput/DateRangeInput own trigger/field semantics; CalendarSurface owns overlay/grid composition.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: boundary grammar; consuming component decides final role
requiredStates: hover/focus container when consuming component is interactive
componentBaselines.notes: Do not assign role from Surface Foundation alone.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: section or region with accessible heading when independently navigable
keyboard: Tab through contained controls in source order
componentBaselines.notes: Section heading and region label are required when the section is a navigation target.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: complementary region or dialog depending on modality
componentBaselines.notes: Modal drawer blocks background focus; non-modal detail drawer must keep focus order explicit.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: article/listitem or button/link when the whole card is actionable
keyboard: Tab to actionable card or inner controls
componentBaselines.notes: Avoid nested conflicting interactive targets.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: section or region for dashboard module
keyboard: focus order from header actions to body content
componentBaselines.notes: Widget title should label the region when the widget is independently navigable.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: tree or disclosure list depending on implementation
componentBaselines.notes: Do not mix tree selection, checkbox checked state, and current navigation state.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: toolbar plus popover/dialog controls for filters and sort rules
componentBaselines.notes: Filter chips need readable labels and removable actions need accessible names.

componentBaselines.roleExpectation: inline status/help text associated with nearby content
componentBaselines.notes: InlineMessage should be associated with the affected control or content region when it explains an error.

coveragePolicy: All active current components must have explicit baselines. Draft, deprecated/history, and example-only entries are tracked in the coverage ledger but are not current implementation truth.
